Quick Definition: What is Text to Speech (TTS)?
Text to Speech (TTS) is an assistive AI speech synthesis technology that converts written digital text into spoken vocal audio waveforms. Modern TTS systems utilize deep neural networks—such as Kokoro-82M, Tacotron 2, and neural vocoders (HiFi-GAN, WaveNet)—to synthesize ultra-realistic human voices complete with context-aware intonation, natural pitch contours, and realistic breathing pauses across global languages.
